Job Description: GenAI Solution Technical Architect

Experience: 1218 years

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced GenAI Solution Technical Architect to lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and technical delivery of a GenAI-powered Assistant that supports IT Operations (ITO) processes in the manufacturing domain.

This role requires a strong combination of enterprise solution design skills and hands-on experience with Generative AI technologies, cloud-native architectures, and scalable application frameworks. The architect will be responsible for defining reference architectures, guiding squads, ensuring quality gates, and enabling seamless integration of GenAI components (LLMs, vector databases, prompt engineering) into enterprise workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Solution Architecture & Design
    • Define the end-to-end architecture for GenAI-enabled applications, including backend (Python/FastAPI), frontend (React), AWS cloud infrastructure, and GenAI services.
    • Design scalable, secure, and compliant architectures that align with enterprise IT standards.
    • Own decisions around RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector search, prompt engineering strategies, and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.).
  • GenAI Integration & Innovation
    • Define patterns for prompt engineering, embeddings, vector and LLM integration.
    • Ensure AI workflows are modular, reusable, and cost-efficient.
  • Technical Leadership & Governance
    • Guide squads (backend, frontend, QA, DevOps) in translating requirements into scalable technical designs.
    • Define coding standards, architecture blueprints, and quality gates.
    • Provide technical leadership during design reviews, sprint planning, and release cycles.
  • Hands-On Contribution
    • Build reference implementations and POCs to validate GenAI use cases.
    • Troubleshoot complex integration challenges across AI, APIs, and cloud services.
    • Remain hands-on in critical technical areas, especially GenAI integrations.
  • Cloud & DevOps Alignment
    • Define AWS-native deployment architecture for scale and resilience.
    • Work with DevOps engineers on CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cost optimization.
    • Ensure compliance with security, governance, and enterprise guardrails.
  • Stakeholder Engagement
    • Collaborate with product owners, business SMEs, and delivery managers to align solution design with business needs.
    • Communicate complex technical concepts in simple, business-aligned terms.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Technical Leadership
    • 12–18 years of overall experience in solution architecture, enterprise systems, or technical leadership.
    • Proven expertise in designing and delivering enterprise-scale applications.
    • Strong background in Python, FastAPI, React-based applications, and AWS cloud.
  • GenAI Expertise (Hands-On)
    • Deep understanding of LLM integration, prompt engineering, embeddings, and RAG workflows.
    • Practical experience with vector databases.
    • Familiarity with GenAI orchestration frameworks
  • Cloud & DevOps
    • Strong experience with AWS services (ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, CloudFront).
    • Knowledge of DevOps pipelines, containerization (Docker), and monitoring frameworks.
    • Ability to optimize GenAI workloads for performance, cost, and scalability.

jobDescription:
About the Role
We are building next-generation GenAI capabilities for a fintech platform, and we are looking for a GenAI / Agent Developer to design and ship production-grade LLM applications.
You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and agentic workflows from prototype to secure, scalable deployment on AWS. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who has moved GenAI from notebooks into real, reliable products handling sensitive financial data.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain RAG pipelines - document ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, re-ranking, and grounded generation.
  • Design and orchestrate multi-step, multi-tool AI agents that plan, call tools/APIs, and complete complex financial workflows reliably.
  • Develop and deploy GenAI solutions on AWS with production standards for scalability, observability, cost control, and security.
  • Implement guardrails, evaluation, and monitoring to ensure accuracy, safety, and hallucination control on financial and regulated content.
  • Integrate LLM services with internal APIs, vector stores, and knowledge/graph layers.
  • Use Claude Code to accelerate development, prototyping, and code review.
  • Partner with backend, semantic, and QA engineers to deliver features end-to-end.
  • Continuously benchmark models, prompts, and retrieval strategies to improve quality, latency, and cost.
Mandatory Skills
  • Python - strong, production-level proficiency (must-have).
  • GenAI / LLM application development - hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered features to production.
  • RAG architecture - practical experience designing retrieval pipelines (chunking, embeddings, retrieval, re-ranking, grounding).
  • AWS - building and deploying applications on AWS services.
  • Claude Code - comfortable using Claude Code (or equivalent AI coding assistants) in daily development.
Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, OpenSearch, FAISS).
  • Agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar).
  • Prompt engineering & evaluation tooling (systematic prompt design, offline/online eval, LLM-as-judge, tracing).
  • Exposure to LLMOps, model observability, and prompt/version management.
  • Experience with regulated or financial data (security, privacy, compliance awareness).
What We Look For
  • A builder who ships: you have taken GenAI features from concept to production, not just demos.
  • Strong grasp of LLM failure modes (hallucination, prompt injection, drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and rapid iteration in a fast-moving product environment.
  • Clear communication and collaboration across engineering and product teams.
Fintech Context
Because this is a fintech platform, awareness of data security, PII handling, and responsible-AI practices for regulated environments is highly valued

title: Expert Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Ciklum is looking for an Expert Data Scientist to join our team full-time in India.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.


About the role:

As an Expert Data Scientist, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. The Expert/Principal Data Scientist is a senior technical leader responsible for setting the standard for evaluation-driven development across the organization's AI/ML and analytics portfolio. This person defines modeling strategy, evaluation frameworks, and delivery governance across multiple 45-day release cycles, and is accountable for demonstrating measurable business impact at a portfolio level while mentoring senior and mid-level data scientists.


Responsibilities:

  • Evaluation-Driven Development Strategy & Standards
    • Define and champion the organization's evaluation-driven development framework: standards for selecting modeling approaches (statistical, ML, optimization, simulation, GenAI), evaluation metric design, and validation methodology
    • Establish enterprise guidelines for aligning evaluation metrics to business and process outcomes, ensuring consistency across teams and products
    • Set standards for the use of synthetic data, historical data, and real-world/controlled validation across the model lifecycle, including approval gates before production rollout
    • Own the definition of "measurable improvement" for the portfolio ensuring every release is backed by a rigorous before/after comparison against business KPIs
  • Delivery Leadership
    • Oversee and be accountable for multiple concurrent workstreams delivered through 45-day versioned agile cycles, ensuring the portfolio consistently ships incremental, measurable value
    • Act as the escalation point for delivery risk, technical trade-offs, and cross-team dependencies across release cycles
    • Partner with product and engineering leadership to prioritize the roadmap based on expected business impact vs. delivery cost/risk
  • Platform, MLOps & Cost
    • Set architectural and MLOps direction for AI/ML platforms and analytics products on AWS, including model deployment patterns, monitoring, and automated governance
    • Own cost-management and performance-optimization strategy for data and ML workloads at scale, setting budgets and efficiency targets across teams
    • Define enterprise approach to synthetic data generation, offline experimentation, and controlled real-world validation, including tooling selection
  • Governance & Compliance
    • Own the framework for balancing model performance, explainability, regulatory compliance, and cost across the portfolio, including escalation criteria for high-risk models
    • Represent the data science function in audits, regulatory reviews, and executive reporting on model governance and business impact
  • Leadership
    • Mentor Senior Data Scientists and review their evaluation frameworks, modeling choices, and delivery outcomes
    • Drive adoption of best practices in evaluation-driven development across the organization

Requirements:

  • Master's or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or related field (or equivalent demonstrated experience)
  • 10+ years of experience delivering data science/ML/analytics solutions, including leadership of technical strategy at a portfolio or platform level
  • Proven track record of selecting and justifying modeling approaches across statistical, ML, optimization, simulation, and GenAI paradigms based on business context
  • Deep experience defining evaluation metrics tied to business and process KPIs, and demonstrating measurable outcomes from delivered models
  • Extensive hands-on and architectural experience with AWS AI/ML platforms and MLOps practices at scale
  • Demonstrated ownership of agile, versioned delivery cycles across multiple teams or products
  • Strong track record balancing model performance, explainability, compliance, and cost trade-offs, including in regulated environments
  • Experience designing synthetic data strategies, offline experimentation frameworks, and controlled real-world validation programs
  • Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills

Desirable:

  • Experience presenting model governance and impact metrics to executive or regulatory audiences
  • Publications, patents, or public speaking in applied ML/AI evaluation methodology
  • Experience building or scaling MLOps platforms from the ground up

  • Define and track delay recovery playbooks, including alternatives such as re-prioritization, partial allocation, and timeline resets.

title: Deputy Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
jobDescription:
Job Summary
To support the PO Lead in execution of App and Web digital product initiatives by managing requirement documentation, stakeholder coordination, UAT execution, defect tracking, release readiness, KPI monitoring and post-live adoption tracking to ensure timely delivery of customer-centric digital journeys and business outcomes.
Responsibilities
  • Requirement gathering and documentation
  • Understand business requirements, customer journey gaps and digital platform enhancement needs from PO Lead and business stakeholders.
  • Prepare BRDs, user stories, process flows, screen-level requirements and acceptance criteria for assigned initiatives.
  • Maintain requirement trackers, dependency logs and version control for all assigned product changes.
  • Coordinate requirement walkthroughs with Technology, Design, Analytics, Operations, Risk and Compliance teams.
  • Product delivery and execution support
  • Support PO Lead in delivery of assigned App and Web product features from requirement finalization to go-live.
  • Track project milestones, sprint progress, open dependencies, issue closures and delivery timelines.
  • Coordinate with IT and cross-functional teams to ensure scope clarity, timely clarifications and execution discipline.
  • Highlight risks, deviations and blockers proactively to the PO Lead for governance and escalation.
  • UAT, defect and release governance
  • Prepare UAT scenarios, test cases and validation checkpoints basis approved requirements and journey flows.
  • Coordinate UAT execution with business users and ensure defects are logged, prioritized and tracked to closure.
  • Validate fixes, maintain defect tracker and support go-live readiness sign-off documentation.
  • Support release notes, SOP updates, launch communication and post-deployment validation activities.
  • KPI monitoring and post-live tracking
  • Track post-live performance for assigned journeys including traffic, leads, funnel conversion, drop-offs and feature adoption.
  • Coordinate with Analytics teams for dashboard validation, data accuracy and metric-level insights.
  • Prepare periodic performance updates and share actionable observations with PO Lead.
  • Support improvement backlog creation based on customer behaviour, KPI trends and business feedback.
  • Customer journey and UI/UX coordination
  • Work with DCX/UI-UX teams to review screen flows, wireframes, content and customer communication for assigned journeys.
  • Identify customer friction points and recommend practical journey improvements to improve completion and conversion.
  • Ensure customer experience guidelines and digital design standards are followed during implementation.
  • Stakeholder coordination and governance reporting
  • Coordinate with Business, PMG, IT, Analytics, Design, Operations, Risk and Compliance teams for assigned initiatives.
  • Prepare project status notes, meeting minutes, action trackers, issue logs and governance updates.
  • Ensure timely follow-up and closure of action items across stakeholders.
  • Process discipline and knowledge management
  • Maintain proper documentation repository for requirements, approvals, UAT evidence, release artefacts and dashboards.
  • Support process standardization and continuous improvement within the POD operating rhythm.
Key Decisions / Dimensions
  • Following decisions are taken by the role:
  • Recommendation on UAT test coverage, defect severity and readiness inputs for release sign-off.
  • Recommendation on requirement clarifications, scope observations and execution dependencies to PO Lead.
  • Identification of journey improvement opportunities based on KPI trends, customer feedback and UAT observations.
  • Escalation of unresolved issues, delayed action items and critical defects to PO Lead.
  • Supports digital business outcomes for assigned App and Web journeys through timely execution, KPI tracking, funnel improvement and adoption monitoring.
Major Challenges
  • Capturing clear requirements and managing frequent changes without impacting committed delivery timelines.
  • Coordinating with multiple stakeholders for timely clarifications, UAT support and defect closure.
  • Ensuring quality UAT execution and release readiness across multiple App and Web journeys.
  • Maintaining accurate KPI tracking and providing actionable insights after go-live.
  • Balancing day-to-day execution activities with structured documentation and governance expectations.
Required Qualifications and Experience

Educational Qualifications
  • Graduation in Engineering, Technology, Management, Business or related discipline.
  • Post-Graduation / MBA preferred but not mandatory.
Work Experience
  • Minimum 4 - 8 years of experience for Manager / 6 - 10 years for Sr. Manager in Digital Product, Project Delivery, Business Analysis, UAT or Digital Platforms.
  • Experience in BFSI / FinTech / Digital Lending / Consumer Platforms preferred.
  • Strong understanding of requirement documentation, UAT management, release governance and digital journey monitoring.
  • Ability to coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders and drive action closure within timelines.
Functional Knowledge
  • BRD/user story preparation, process mapping, UAT execution, defect tracking, release readiness, KPI monitoring, dashboard validation, App/Web customer journeys and stakeholder coordination.

At SIXT, AI is changing how work gets done and we are looking for the person who will help us do it safely. As an AI Security Engineer, you will shape how SIXT understands, assesses, and secures AI usage across the organisation, exploring where AI touches our data and systems, defining what safe usage looks like, and building the detections and controls that keep AI behaviour secure. This is a builders role at the frontier of a fast-moving field handson, high-ownership, and directly influential in making responsible AI adoption real at a global scale. If you are excited about defining what secure AI looks like inside a world-class organisation, apply now and become part of Team Orange.

  • You assess AI tooling and AI-built applications across SIXT, identify and derive associated security risks, and present clear, actionable findings to relevant stakeholders for informed decision-making
  • You author remediation policies that keep AI usage inside agreed boundaries, automating enforcement so it does not depend on manual review
  • You partner with teams and business units building their own AI-powered tools, steering them toward more secure approaches and making risk-based decisions on what AI usage is acceptable
  • You define the baseline of healthy, productive AI usage that SIXT should actively encourage, and track progress through clear KPIs that show how risk is being reduced over time
  • You respond to AI-related security incidents, containing issues quickly and decisively, and work continuously with security and engineering teams to improve and automate AI governance controls

jobDescription:
AI Architect GenAI, SLM & AI Practice

Position Overview

We are looking for a hands-on AI Architect who can lead and build our AI/GenAI practice, with a strong focus on designing and developing domain-specific Small Language Models (SLMs) and enterprise AI solutions.

The ideal candidate will have deep practical experience across LLMs, SLMs, RAG, AI Agents, model training/fine-tuning, data engineering and cloud AI platforms. The person should be capable of taking an industry-specific business problem, determining the appropriate AI/model approach, defining the required components, building the model/solution, and taking it into production.

This role requires someone who can architect as well as engineernot just consume existing foundation models or build applications on top of APIs.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead AI & GenAI Practice

  • Define and drive the organization's AI/GenAI technology strategy and practice.
  • Establish AI architecture standards, reusable frameworks, accelerators and reference architectures.
  • Identify high-value AI opportunities across different industries and customer environments.
  • Lead development of AI solutions from ideation PoC model development production deployment.
  • Build and mentor AI/ML/GenAI engineering teams.
  • Provide technical leadership for AI solutioning, proposals and customer engagements.
  • Establish best practices for AI governance, security, evaluation, responsible AI and cost optimization.

2. Domain-Specific SLM Architecture & Development

A key responsibility of this role is to design and build Small Language Models for specific industries/domains.

The candidate should be able to independently determine and define the key components required to build a domain-specific SLM, including:

  • Define the business and industry problem that the SLM needs to solve.
  • Determine whether an SLM, LLM, RAG or a combination of these is the appropriate approach.
  • Define the required model architecture and model size based on the use case.
  • Evaluate whether to:
    • Build a model from scratch
    • Adapt an existing open-source foundation model
    • Fine-tune an existing LLM/SLM
    • Use knowledge distillation
    • Use LoRA/PEFT or other parameter-efficient techniques
    • Combine an SLM with RAG and external tools
  • Define the required industry/domain-specific datasets.

title: Data Quality Lead
jobDescription:
Specialist, Data Quality & Responsible AI Control Operations

Role Summary

The Specialist, Data Quality & Responsible AI Control Operations is a hands-on role responsible for implementing, maintaining, and improving data quality and AI data readiness controls across authorized data sources, data products, and AI use cases. This role supports the connection between data architecture, hands-on data modeling, data management, Responsible AI, and control operations to help ensure AI products consume governed, traceable, fit-for-purpose, and high-quality data. The ideal candidate brings practical experience in data quality engineering, data modeling, data governance, metadata, lineage, control execution, and automation, with the ability to work closely with domain, technology, risk, compliance, audit, and AI governance stakeholders.

Team Context

This role sits at the intersection of Data Management & Governance, enterprise data quality assurance, Responsible AI operations, data architecture, and technology risk management. The position supports execution of quality and governance requirements in the flow of delivery by helping embed controls into data sourcing, ADS and data product certification, metadata and lineage workflows, pipeline validation, AI lifecycle gates, monitoring, exception management, remediation, recertification, and evidence generation. The role will contribute to control-plane capabilities that provide visibility into AI data readiness, data quality health, control coverage, exceptions, incidents, remediation status, and audit-ready evidence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement data quality and AI data readiness controls across authorized data sources, data products, semantic products, and AI use cases.
  • Support definition and application of AI-ready data criteria, including quality thresholds, lineage completeness, metadata completeness, source authorization, classification, access controls, issue history, freshness, and remediation expectations.
  • Translate Responsible AI control requirements into practical data control tasks, test cases, rule logic, evidence requirements, and implementation steps.
  • Partner with data architects, data engineering, platform, and domain teams to implement controls across ingestion, transformation, publication, semantic access, AI consumption, and runtime monitoring.
  • Perform hands-on data modeling across conceptual, logical, physical, canonical, and semantic models to support trusted data products, ADS certification, AI consumption patterns, and downstream DQ control design.
  • Configure and maintain DQ rules, thresholds, evidence payloads, control templates, metadata mappings, and implementation artifacts using approved patterns.
  • Work with domain teams to define DQ rules, set thresholds, emit raw DQ metrics, manage exceptions, remediate issues, and provide evidence in alignment with central governance expectations.
  • Execute recurring data profiling, rule runs, exception reviews, issue triage, root-cause analysis support, remediation tracking, retesting, recertification, and closure evidence.
  • Support integration of data quality controls into AI lifecycle gates so AI products use fit-for-purpose, authorized, governed, traceable, and appropriately controlled data sources.
  • Maintain control library entries for data quality, AI data readiness, metadata, lineage, access, privacy, monitoring, certification, and lifecycle governance.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities that reduce manual governance effort while improving traceability, repeatability, defensibility, and audit readiness.
  • Build and maintain monitoring thresholds, alerts, KRIs, KPIs, control effectiveness measures, dashboards, and reports that show data quality health, AI data readiness, exceptions, and remediation progress.
  • Coordinate with business owners, product teams, data domains, platform engineering, architecture, security, privacy, legal, compliance, risk, model risk, and audit to support execution of control requirements.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation, including control mappings, rule logic, test results, workflow decisions, approvals, exceptions, incident records, remediation evidence, and management reporting inputs.
  • Contribute to playbooks, standards, implementation guidance, training, and enablement materials that help business and technology teams adopt DQ and RAI control practices.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Practical experience in enterprise data quality, data governance, data management, data architecture, technology controls, Responsible AI operations, or a closely related discipline within a complex enterprise environment.
  • Good understanding of enterprise data architecture, hands-on data modeling, authorized data sources, data products, data contracts, metadata, lineage, semantic layers, access controls, and governed lakehouse or cloud data platform patterns.
  • Hands-on experience designing, reviewing, or maintaining conceptual, logical, physical, canonical, dimensional, domain, and semantic data models, including entity relationships, critical data elements, business definitions, data contracts, and AI-consumable semantic structures.
  • Hands-on knowledge of data quality practices, including rule design, profiling, thresholds, data observability, reconciliation, anomaly detection, issue management, remediation, and quality scorecards.
  • Ability to connect data quality outcomes to Responsible AI control needs, including traceability, data suitability, representativeness, bias/proxy-risk considerations, privacy constraints, monitoring, and lifecycle governance.
  • Experience implementing controls in pipelines, workflows, platforms, certification routines, metadata systems, or CI/CD processes rather than relying solely on manual review.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML, generative AI, agentic AI, model lifecycle management, model registries, evaluation workflows, monitoring, and production release controls.
  • Ability to convert policy, regulatory, and control expectations into practical tasks, acceptance criteria, testing steps, operating routines, and evidence artifacts.
  • Experience working with cross-functional control partners such as risk, compliance, legal, privacy, information security, model risk, internal audit, and business control teams.
  • Ability to support metrics and dashboards that communicate control coverage, control effectiveness, exceptions, incidents, data quality health, AI data readiness, and remediation progress.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and governance concepts clearly to practitioners, stakeholders, and control partners.
  • Strong execution skills, including backlog support, stakeholder follow-up, decision documentation, issue tracking, control testing, and delivery against milestones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, insurance, healthcare, or another environment with strong risk, privacy, security, and audit expectations.
  • Experience with Data Quality, Responsible AI, AI governance, data governance, model risk management, technology risk, or operational risk frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of data quality and observability tools, metadata/catalog platforms, lineage tooling, workflow tools, cloud platforms, issue management systems, and reporting/dashboarding tools.
  • Experience supporting DQ rule libraries, control catalogs, evidence schemas, certification criteria, policy mappings, AI data suitability checks, or automated control testing routines.
  • Experience supporting operating models, RACI, decision rights, adoption playbooks, metrics, and executive or management reporting routines.
  • Technical fluency with SQL, Python, APIs, YAML/JSON configuration, rules engines, test automation, metadata definitions, data modeling artifacts, or related engineering practices is strongly preferred.
  • Bachelors degree in computer science, data science, engineering, information systems, risk management, or a related field; relevant certifications preferred.

Relevant Tools and Technology Exposure

  • Data quality and data observability tools: Experience with platforms that support profiling, rule management, quality thresholds, anomaly detection, freshness monitoring, reconciliation, schema drift detection, issue management, and quality dashboards; examples include Ataccama ONE Data Quality, Informatica Data Quality, Collibra Data Quality, Soda, Monte Carlo, and Great Expectations or equivalent tools.
  • Metadata, catalog, lineage, and data governance platforms: Working knowledge of cataloging, glossary management, metadata harvesting, lineage mapping, data ownership, stewardship workflows, data product certification, and policy mapping capabilities; examples include Informatica CDGC, Collibra, Microsoft Purview, Alation, OpenLineage, and related catalog or governance platforms.
  • Responsible AI, AI governance, agentic AI, and ModelOps platforms: Familiarity with AI use case intake, model or agent registries, model risk workflows, evaluation tooling, monitoring, lifecycle governance, runtime guardrails, and AI control evidence; examples include IBM watsonx.governance, AWS AgentCore, AWS Guardrails, Azure AI Studio, Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, Databricks Mosaic AI, and model registry or monitoring platforms.
  • Cloud, data platform, and lakehouse technologies: Familiarity with enterprise data and AI environments across modern cloud platforms, governed lakehouse architectures, warehouses, object storage, semantic layers, and pipeline-based data delivery; examples include AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and similar enterprise data platforms.
  • Pipeline, orchestration, and automation tooling: Experience embedding governance and quality checks into data pipelines, workflow orchestration, CI/CD, monitoring routines, and automated evidence generation; examples include Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, dbt, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, and equivalent orchestration or DevOps tooling.
  • Workflow, issue management, and reporting tools: Ability to use or partner on workflows, dashboards, scorecards, exception reporting, remediation tracking, and executive reporting to communicate control health and adoption progress; examples include ServiceNow, Jira, Power BI, Tableau, and similar workflow or reporting platforms.
  • Technical languages, modeling, and configuration skills: Practical fluency with SQL and Python, hands-on data modeling, plus comfort reading or writing APIs, YAML, JSON, Git-based configuration, rule logic, metadata definitions, semantic definitions, and reusable control templates.

What Success Looks Like

  • Data quality and AI data readiness controls are implemented accurately in delivery workflows, pipelines, certification routines, and platforms.
  • AI products are supported by governed, traceable, fit-for-purpose, and appropriately controlled data from certified or approved sources.
  • DQ and RAI control checks are executed consistently and supported by clear, repeatable, audit-ready evidence.
  • Dashboards and reports provide timely visibility into data quality health, AI data readiness, exceptions, incidents, remediation, and control effectiveness.
  • Domain, product, engineering, and data teams receive practical support on how to implement controls and demonstrate compliance without unnecessary friction.
  • DQ rules, evidence patterns, control library updates, modeling artifacts, and operating routines are maintained with accuracy, consistency, and traceability.

jobDescription:
HEAD OF DELIVERY

Enterprise AI Solutions

Company

Oriserve (oriserve.com)

Location

Noida, India (office-based, with client travel)

Experience

818 years

Reports to

Founders

Direct Reports

Pod Managers, Engagement Managers, and Project Managers


Why This Role Exists

Delivery is where Oriserve's value is realised. Every dollar of recurring revenue flows through client programs that this function owns from post-sale handoff through go-live, steady-state operations, expansion, and renewal.

As we scale, we need a leader who can institutionalise delivery excellence someone who builds a team of client-facing consultants (not project trackers), drives revenue realisation across the portfolio, and ensures every client engagement creates demonstrable business impact.

This person will lead the entire delivery and operations program, set the quality and governance standards, and build the team's capability to independently manage complex enterprise accounts end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities


Revenue Ownership & Commercial Accountability

Own the delivery P&L revenue under management, go-live velocity, expansion revenue, retention, and delivery margins across the full client portfolio.

Drive revenue realisation reduce signing-to-billing timelines, convert POCs into production, expand existing accounts through demonstrated value, and retain clients through proactive relationship management.

Commercial rigour partner with Finance on billing accuracy, collections, and forecasting. Ensure no revenue leaks across the portfolio.


Client Leadership & Business Depth

Be the strategic partner to enterprise clients build executive trust, run business reviews, maintain account roadmaps, and translate client outcomes (containment rates, conversion uplift, collections recovery) into delivery plans.

Drive expansion turn delivered value into new use cases, geographies, and lines of business. Work with Sales to create accurate, delivery-ready scope packages.

Set the communication standard every client touchpoint — from check-ins to quarterly reviews — should reflect consulting-grade quality, rigour, and professionalism.


Delivery Operations & Governance

Build and enforce a delivery lifecycle — from handoff through go-live, hyper-care, steady-state, and renewal — with clear stage gates, accountability, and visibility at every step.

Operating rhythm — establish weekly, monthly, and quarterly review cadences that keep projects on track, surface risks early, and connect delivery performance to revenue outcomes.

Decisive on stalling projects — no project should go invisible or consume resources without a clear path to production and revenue. Build governance that prevents zombie projects.

Infrastructure and cost discipline — ensure every deployment is tracked from Day 1, and decommissioned promptly when a client churns. Zero waste.


Quality & Reliability

Production quality standards — enforce structured post go-live reviews, incident management discipline, and measurable AI quality benchmarks that improve over time.

Documentation and artifact discipline — business reviews backed by data, check-ins documented, every scope change recorded. If it isn't documented, it didn't happen.


People Leadership

Build consultants, not coordinators — coach Pod Managers and PMs on client management, structured problem-solving, commercial thinking, and written communication. Develop business depth across the team.

Structured performance management — clear KRAs per person, quarterly reviews linked to incentives, decisive action on underperformance, and a high hiring bar for new team members.

Scale the team — structure pods by account complexity, define the capability model, and build a bench that grows without diluting quality.


Ideal Candidate Profile


Core Experience

8–18 years — in delivery leadership, program management, or engagement management at a B2B SaaS company, enterprise AI/tech firm, IT services leader, or top-tier consulting firm.

P&L accountability — has directly owned revenue realisation and delivery margins — not just project execution. Understands the difference between "project delivered" and "revenue collected."

Team leadership — has built and managed delivery teams of 8+ people, including Pod Managers or Engagement Managers with their own client portfolios.

Enterprise delivery experience — BFSI or Telecom strongly preferred. Understands the compliance, procurement, and stakeholder complexity of large Indian enterprises.


Problem Solving & Analytics

Structured thinker who converts ambiguity into measurable plans and evidence-based decisions.

Comfortable with financial models, funnel analysis, capacity planning, and operational dashboards.


Communication & Stakeholder Leadership

Outstanding written and verbal communication — sets the quality bar for the entire team.

Earns trust with senior client stakeholders. Can have a business conversation with a CXO, not just a status update.

Fluent in English and Hindi.


Education

Postgraduate or advanced degree from a reputed institution (MBA / Engineering / Analytics or equivalent).


Mindset

Ownership — spots risks and opportunities before they become escalations.

Commercially minded — thinks in revenue, margin, and client lifetime value.

Process builder — creates systems that scale, not just solves individual problems.

Team-first leader — high standards with coaching, not just criticism.


Nice-to-Have

Experience with Conversational AI, voice bots, chatbots, or contact centre automation.

Familiarity with CCaaS, telephony (SIP/dialers), or API-driven integrations.

Experience with AI/ML-powered products in production environments.


What Makes This Role Different


This is not a traditional delivery management role. At Oriserve:

You own the revenue line — delivery and commercial success are the same thing.

Your team's work powers over 1.5 million AI conversations daily for India's leading enterprises. The domain is cutting-edge, the stakes are real.

You will build the delivery function's operating system — standards, governance, incentives, and team capability — from the ground up.

You work directly with the founders on strategy, pricing, and client decisions. This is a leadership seat, not a middle-management role.

Your team uses AI tools daily for analysis, documentation, and decision-making — operating at the frontier of AI-assisted delivery.

jobDescription:
VP Human Resources
Company: Berkowits Hair & Skin Clinics

Reporting To: CEO / Leadership Team
Team Size: 5 HR Professionals
Monthly Compensation: up to 1,00,000
Employment Type: Full-Time
About the Role
Berkowits Hair & Skin Clinics is looking for a young, dynamic, execution-oriented, and AI-native VP Human Resources to lead the HR function across the organization.
This is not a conventional HR leadership role focused primarily on policies and administration. We are looking for someone who is **highly data-driven, comfortable with technology, strong at execution, and capable of building scalable HR systems** for a rapidly growing multi-location organization.
The VP HR will manage a team of approximately 5 HR professionals and will be responsible for ensuring that recruitment, payroll, incentives, performance management, employee engagement, and HR operations run with high levels of accuracy and discipline.
Key Responsibilities
1. HR Leadership & Team Management
* Lead and manage the HR team of approximately 5 professionals.
* Define clear responsibilities, KRAs, and measurable targets for each HR team member.
* Conduct weekly HR reviews and ensure timely closure of pending activities.
* Build a high-accountability and execution-focused culture within the HR team.
* Identify opportunities to automate and simplify repetitive HR processes.
2. HR MIS & Analytics
Own the monthly HR dashboard and track key organizational HR metrics, including:
* Employee Headcount
* Manpower Cost
* HR Budget vs Actual
* Employee Attrition
* New Joinees
* Exits
* Open Positions
* Recruitment TAT
* Offer-to-Joining Ratio
* Employee Productivity Metrics
* Attendance and Leave Trends
* Payroll Variances
* Incentive Payouts
Present a structured Monthly HR MIS to the management team with insights, trends, and recommended actions.
3. Recruitment & Manpower Planning
* Own recruitment tracking across departments and locations.
* Ensure manpower requirements are captured and prioritized.
* Track recruitment TAT for every open position.
* Monitor recruiter performance and recruitment funnel metrics.
* Improve sourcing, screening, and interview processes.
* Build AI-assisted recruitment workflows to improve productivity and candidate quality.
* Develop talent pipelines for frequently hired positions.
4. Payroll & Incentive Processing
* Ensure accurate and timely payroll processing every month.
* Coordinate attendance, leave, salary revisions, deductions, and employee changes.
* Ensure payroll data is reconciled before salary processing.
* Oversee monthly employee incentive calculations and payouts.
* Create checks and controls to minimize payroll and incentive errors.
5. Performance Management
* Manage the employee performance review calendar.
* Ensure quarterly and periodic reviews are completed on time.
* Track employee KRAs, performance ratings, and review completion.
* Coordinate salary revisions, promotions, and performance improvement plans.
* Build structured performance dashboards for leadership.
6. Quarterly Corporate Reviews
* Plan and coordinate Quarterly Corporate Reviews.
* Ensure departments submit performance data and presentations on time.
* Track commitments and action items arising from reviews.
* Maintain follow-up dashboards to ensure closure.
7. Rewards & Recognition
* Own the company-wide Rewards & Recognition program.
* Create transparent criteria for employee recognition.
* Ensure regular recognition of high performers and exceptional contributions.
* Develop innovative engagement and recognition initiatives.
8. Employee Lifecycle Management
Ensure timely completion and compliance of:
* Employee documentation
* Offer Letters
* Joining formalities
* Induction
* Probation reviews
* Employee confirmations
* Transfers and promotions
* Exit interviews
* Full & Final settlement coordination
* Clearance procedures
* Experience and relieving letters
9. HR Systems & Automation
* Drive effective adoption of Keka and other HR technology platforms.
* Identify processes that can be automated using AI and workflow tools.
* Create AI-assisted systems for recruitment, employee communication, HR analytics, documentation and reporting.
* Build standardized HR SOPs and dashboards.
Key Performance Indicators
The VP HR will be evaluated primarily on:
* Recruitment TAT
* Attrition Rate
* Manpower Cost vs Budget
* Payroll Accuracy
* Incentive Processing Accuracy
* HR MIS Accuracy & Timeliness
* Employee Onboarding Completion
* Employee Offboarding Completion
* Performance Review Completion Rate
* HR Team Productivity
* Closure of HR Action Items
* Employee Query Resolution TAT
* Adoption of HR Automation & AI
Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who is:
Young, energetic, and highly execution-oriented
* Comfortable working in a fast-growing organization
* Extremely strong with numbers, dashboards, and MIS
* Comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions
* Process-driven but willing to challenge inefficient processes
* Strong at managing teams and following up relentlessly
* Excellent at Excel / Google Sheets and HR technology
* Experienced with HRMS platforms such as Keka
* Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or similar platforms
* Curious about automation and constantly looking for ways to make HR faster and more efficient
AI-Native Mindset
For Berkowits, being AI-native*means using AI as part of everyday work rather than treating it as an occasional tool.
The successful candidate should be comfortable using AI for activities such as:
* Creating HR dashboards and reports
* Analysing attrition data
* Drafting JDs and employee communications
* Screening and summarizing candidate profiles
* Creating interview questions
* Building SOPs
* Analysing employee feedback
* Preparing management presentations
* Automating repetitive HR workflows
We are looking for someone who naturally asks:
Can technology or AI help us do this faster, better, or with fewer errors?
What Success Looks Like
Within the first 612 months, the successful candidate should have created an HR function where:
* Management has complete visibility into HR numbers.
* Recruitment positions are tracked rigorously.
* Payroll and incentives are processed accurately and on time.
* Employee onboarding and exits happen through clearly defined workflows.
* Performance reviews happen according to schedule.
* HR decisions are increasingly driven by data.
* Repetitive HR activities are progressively automated.
* The HR team operates with clear KRAs, accountability, and measurable outcomes.

title: Product Owner
jobDescription:
Product Owner – Digital Employee Journey

Chennai, India

Our 18,000 colleagues use their expertise every day to shape sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. In the Digital Employee Journey function at Ramboll, we are committed to removing friction and enabling our colleagues with great technology and capabilities so that they can focus on this important mission. Are you energised by the possibilities of AI to improve how people access information and support? Are you motivated to help shape a digital employee experience that enables Ramboll's 18,000+ colleagues across 35 countries? Are you a curious, employee-first product manager who believes that great experiences are built on well-designed workflows and well-governed systems?

If this sounds like you, or you're curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Digital Employee Journey team as our new Product Owner.

Your new role

As our new Product Owner, you will join the Digital Employee Journey team on a permanent basis, reporting to the Head of Digital Employee Journey and working closely day-to-day to support our Senior Product owners for Digital Employee Support and Digital Workplace.

Your role will evolve with business needs for product management of our core employee-facing products for collaboration, communication, support, and general productivity.

Your focus during the first 5 months of this permanent position will be on covering key areas of the Digital Employee Support product area while the Senior Product owner is on parental leave. This includes how employees access support, self-service, and knowledge across digital channels such as assisted support and ServiceNow.

You will also collaborate with the Digital Workplace Senior Product Owner on knowledge management and digital employee experience (DEX) topics.

Based in our Chennai office, you will work alongside a global, international community of Tech Partners, Tech Operations colleagues, engineering and build partners, data and AI specialists, the Digital Adoption team, and enabling functions at Ramboll. You will be exposed to a wide range of stakeholders across the business with the opportunity to develop a strong network across our business.

Expect a collaborative, outcomes-driven environment where employee advocacy, AI-enabled experiences, and product ownership are championed.

Your key responsibilities will be:

  • Owning employee experience-led product roadmaps and acting as the day-to-day decision point for cross-product trade-offs with key stakeholders — framing product work in terms of experience outcomes and value created in end-to-end employee journeys following established principles and standards. Enforcing standards and resolving experience-level questions and escalations (e.g. where multiple SME stakeholders are involved). Defining requirements for operational execution by the Tech Operations team.
  • product management skills looking after enterprise level products, how they manage the roadmap, how they manage budget, initiatives and its future within the company.
  • how they have managed an update or an enhancement to a product and experience of delivering an enterprise level upgrade
  • Understanding of the users and how they use the product and how this can be aligned to successful product delivery
  • examples of products they have managed and what they achieved whilst managing them
  • Interim covering the Digital Employee Support  product ownership —Setting requirements, frameworks and roadmap for how digital employee support services are designed across Ramboll, with a focus on consistency, scalability, and employee centricity. This includes standardising patterns for support journeys across service areas such as technology, workplace, and HR-related services.
  • Supporting Senior Product Owners for Digital Workplace and Digital Employee Support— providing day-to-day support and sparring across both product areas, with a particular focus in your first several months on knowledge management and DEX topics that span Digital Employee Support and the Digital Workplace.
  • Co-developing the knowledge management framework as a cross-team collaboration — partnering with the Digital Workplace product team, the adoption team, and other key stakeholders across our enabling functions and the business to ensure content is user-centric, structured for scale, and fit for both human-assisted and AI-driven support.
  • Further developing our DEX and efficiency metrics — building on existing measurement approaches to mature how we track digital employee experience and efficiency, contributing to broader Ramboll Tech KPIs, and turning product usage and support data into meaningful insight that informs prioritization and continuous improvement.
Qualification

About you

  • Proven experience as a Product Owner for employee-facing support and/or digital workplace products in a large matrix organization, with a track record of developing and owning a product roadmap, managing a product budget, and leading agile sprints for continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms — ServiceNow and the Microsoft 365 suite are an advantage — including how these products support employee service delivery, self-service, knowledge, and the everyday digital workplace.
  • Energised by the possibilities of AI — you see a future where friction to accessing information and services is removed, while systems of record and SME accountability remain clear and well governed in the backend; working knowledge of AI within Enterprise Service Management systems and/or Microsoft 365 (Office, OneNote, Teams, OneDrive), SharePoint (intranet and storage platform governance), and Power Platform is a strong advantage. Highlight any demonstrated experience in these systems (or similar) in your application.  
  • Strong product management driven by data and value creation — able to keep initiatives moving, manage a prioritised backlog across multiple stakeholders, and translate data from a wide range of sources (including product usage data) into strategies and meaningful outcomes for employees and the business. Demonstrating KPI/SLA creation and tracking is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent stakeholder and people skills — able to handle escalations and user questions independently, conduct your own research, and bring a can-do attitude to finding the right person or solution; demonstrate excellent communication skills in English.
Additional Information

What we can offer you

  • Commitment to your development
  • Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles
  • A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are
  • Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
  • Flexible work environment
  • Medical and life insurance
  • Generous leave entitlement each calendar year
  • Opportunities to collaborate with international teams across 35 countries.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application and CV online. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

We recognise that some candidates only apply when they tick every box. However, passion and potential often outweigh a perfect resume and Ramboll's supportive learning culture can help you grow. So if this role resonates with you but you don't meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for this opportunity or another within our team.

Ampity helps companies solve complex technology challenges through cloud and AWS, software engineering, DevOps, data, AI, and managed technology services.We are looking for a senior, hands-on sales professional who can personally build and close business now and later recruit and lead Ampity’s sales organization.


Role Summary

As Founding Head of Sales, you will own the complete B2B sales cycle: market development, account research, prospecting, discovery, solution coordination, proposal development, negotiation, closure, forecasting, and account expansion.

This is not a coordination-only leadership position. During the initial stage, you must be willing and capable of executing independently. Once a repeatable sales model has been established, you will build and lead the sales team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Ampity’s B2B sales strategy for the US market.
  • Define priority industries, ideal customer profiles, buyer personas, and target accounts.
  • Personally generate qualified opportunities through outbound prospecting, referrals, partnerships, events, and professional relationships.
  • Build relationships with CTOs, CIOs, engineering leaders, IT leaders, and business decision-makers.
  • Conduct consultative discovery and understand customers’ business and technology challenges.
  • Work with Ampity’s technical teams to design suitable solutions.
  • Prepare and present proposals, statements of work, commercial models, and business cases.
  • Lead negotiations, procurement discussions, and contract closure.
  • Develop strategic account and expansion plans.
  • Establish sales stages, qualification criteria, CRM discipline, dashboards, and forecasting.
  • Create Ampity’s sales playbook, including messaging, discovery, objection handling, proposals, and follow-up.
  • Build technology partnerships, channel relationships, and referral networks.
  • Recruit, coach, and manage SDRs, Account Executives, partnership resources, and sales operations professionals as the company grows.
  • Own pipeline, new revenue, gross margin, conversion, and forecast accuracy.

Required Experience and Skills

  • 7–12+ years of B2B sales or business-development experience.
  • Proven experience selling IT services, cloud/AWS, software development, DevOps, managed services, data, AI, or cybersecurity solutions.
  • Experience selling to US or international customers.
  • Demonstrable record of personally sourcing, progressing, negotiating, and closing contracts.
  • Strong consultative selling, account planning, discovery, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Ability to communicate credibly with executive and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial judgment, ownership, resilience, and problem-solving ability.
  • Experience building a new sales function or entering a new market is preferred.
  • Existing relationships with technology decision-makers are a significant advantage.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment with strong communication and execution discipline.
  • Willingness to support meetings across relevant US time zones.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for important customer, partner, or leadership meetings.

AI-Native Approach

The successful candidate should use AI and automation intelligently for:

  • Account and industry research.
  • Buying-signal identification.
  • Account prioritization.
  • Personalized outreach.
  • Meeting preparation and call analysis.
  • Follow-ups and opportunity management.
  • Proposal development.
  • Pipeline analysis and forecasting.
  • Sales playbook and coaching improvements.

AI should increase speed and productivity without reducing originality, accuracy, or relationship quality.

First 90-Day Expectations

  • Understand Ampity’s capabilities, offers, customer proof, and delivery model.
  • Refine the ICP, target-account criteria, buyer groups, and sales messaging.
  • Establish a disciplined CRM, pipeline, and forecasting process.
  • Build and activate a prioritized account list.
  • Generate qualified conversations with target decision-makers.
  • Progress suitable opportunities through discovery, technical validation, and proposal.
  • Develop the first version of Ampity’s repeatable sales playbook.
  • Present a hiring plan for the future sales team based on proven requirements.

Performance Measures

  • Qualified pipeline created.
  • Contracts and revenue closed.
  • Gross margin quality.
  • Qualified opportunities.
  • Stage-to-stage conversion.
  • Average contract value.
  • Sales-cycle duration.
  • Forecast accuracy.
  • Partnerships and referrals activated.
  • Customer expansion opportunities.

Location and Working Model

This is a remote position. Candidates based in Pune or Mumbai will be preferred because occasional in-person strategy, team, customer, or partner meetings may be required.

Location will not outweigh capability, and exceptional candidates from other parts of India are encouraged to apply.

Selection Assignment

Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical assignment limited to approximately three hours.

Candidates will receive a description of Ampity’s capabilities, two sample offers, and a list of sample US target accounts.

The assignment will include:

  1. Select and justify five priority target accounts.
  2. Identify the likely problem, buyer group, and buying trigger for each account.
  3. Create an account-entry strategy for one selected company.
  4. Write one personalized email and LinkedIn message.
  5. Design a six-touch outreach sequence.
  6. Conduct a 15-minute mock discovery call.
  7. Present a practical 90-day pipeline-development plan.
  8. Explain which sales role should be hired first after the sales motion is proven.

Candidates may use AI but must explain how it was used and what they independently verified.

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your resume or LinkedIn profile.
  • The most relevant B2B technology-services deal you personally sourced and closed.
  • Approximate deal value, sales cycle, buyer type, and your individual contribution.
  • An example of how you use AI in your sales workflow.
  • Current location, notice period, and compensation expectations.

Candidates must not disclose confidential information from current or former employers.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI & ML Data Collection, you will play a critical role in building and scaling the companys Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform, enabling standardized, reliable, and scalable machine learning capabilities across the organization. This role will focus on transforming existing AI/ML and LLM-driven data systems into a cohesive platform that supports data pipelines, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, and production deployment.

This position requires deep hands-on expertise in machine learning engineering, LLM-based systems, ML platform development, and MLOps. You will work closely with ML engineers, product managers, researchers, and business stakeholders to deliver production-ready AI/ML systems aligned with broader business objectives and AI/ML strategy.

You will be deeply involved in the design, development, and operationalization of platform components, including data ingestion, feature management, model training and evaluation, scalable inference systems, and model observability capabilities.

You will help ensure that AI/ML systems are production-ready, observable, maintainable, and cost-efficient, with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, governance, and developer productivity. You will leverage your expertise in areas such as large language models (LLM), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and ML Operations (MLOps).

You will contribute to the end-to-end lifecycle of ML systems, from experimentation and prototyping to deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement while mentoring engineers and promoting strong engineering practices across the team.


Team Overview

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of ML engineers responsible for building and maintaining the Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform. The team focuses on developing scalable systems that support data pipelines, model lifecycle management, LLM-based workflows, and evaluation frameworks, enabling downstream teams to build and deploy AI-driven data collection solutions.

title: Engineering Manager - Experience Content Platforms
jobDescription:
We are seeking an Engineering Manager - Experience Content Platforms


Role location: Bangalore
Experience: 12+ years


Role Overview
Content Generation owns the foundations of how content is created, localized, and governed at scale across a global, multilingual product.

As Engineering Manager, you will manage a cross-functional team of engineers implementing the content strategy, leading the transition of these foundations into an AI-native model where copy agents generate copy and translations at design and code time, QA runs continuously, and changes ship and are tested across markets at once, cutting time-to-market and cost. You will own the guardrails that keep this trustworthy, including governance and compliance, accuracy, brand consistency, and robust evaluation of agent output. Success depends on aligning a complex set of stakeholders, from UX writers, designers, product, and engineering to localization, experimentation, legal, and senior leadership.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:

As a Software Engineering Manager you are responsible for managing a team of engineers and working closely with product and tech stakeholders across the track and area to ensure timely and quality delivery of the roadmap.

Important aspects of the job include

  • Inspire and develop individuals by helping create personal development plans, leveraging learning resources, and offering stretch opportunities for growth.
  • Manage performance effectively by setting and reviewing clear objectives and KPIs, providing timely feedback, and collaborating closely with HR counterparts when needed.
  • Ensure delivery through ownership by being proactive, collaborating with peers and stakeholders, tracking roadmap progress, and resolving or escalating blockers.
    Manage team stakeholders by clearly and regularly reporting progress and blockers to ensure transparency and alignment.
  • Support recruitment and planning by participating in headcount planning and involving your team in hiring processes.
  • Coach and mentor colleagues across levels by sharing your experience, knowledge, and approaches to work to improve overall performance.
  • Own systems end to end by monitoring application health and performance, setting and responding to relevant metrics, and guiding junior team members in these practices.
    Reduce operational risk by applying state-of-the-art tools and practices, maintaining clear documentation (e.g. runbooks, OpDocs), and improving business continuity and the bus factor.
  • Improve system reliability by addressing live production issues within SLA, contributing to root cause analysis, and logging and learning from incidents via postmortems.
    Build high-quality software by applying relevant development languages, using standard libraries and design patterns, and following testing strategies that ensure security, integrity, and quality.
  • Guide architectural decisions by advising on technical solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements and aligning improvements with the wider architectural landscape.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying and implementing improvements in processes, systems, and structures, and by applying critical thinking to evaluate and develop ideas.

Role Qualifications and Requirements - Must-Haves:

  • 8 to 12 years of experience in building enterprise software products. Previous experience as a developer will be preferred
  • 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager (must be a dedicated management role, not a temporary caretaking assignment).
  • Ability to read and understand code and apply simple design patterns to refactor code and ensure quality standard by applying testing strategies
  • Maintain data security, integrity and quality by following company standards, best practices and relevant legislation.
  • Ability to evaluate possible architecture solutions by considering the cost, business requirements, technology requirements and emerging technologies.
  • Ability to describe the implications for changing an existing system or adding a new system to a specific area, by having a broad, high-level understanding of the infrastructure and architecture of our systems.
  • Ability to help grow the business and/or accelerate software development by applying engineering techniques (e.g. prototyping, spiking and vendor evaluation) and technical standards.
